story.title: We like our sauces handmade. Our burgers even more.
story.p1: MANCH is a smash burger zone in Paspatur, Fethiye's historic bazaar. Daily patties, butter brioche, sauces from the MANCH kitchen — berry and roasted pepper alike.
story.p2: Smash from the kitchen, first bite from the table. Flavor levels may have gotten a little out of control — we consider that a feature. We also take tiramisu seriously.
story.points: 120 g beef patty, smashed|Homemade berry & roasted pepper sauce|Butter brioche, baked daily|Real mascarpone tiramisu|Blue tile wall, pink checkered paper
